title: Spartan wave 5 art
whats_new: Round 2 for the page note "ensure these all have proper mod material handles and such if appropriate". The four metals keep the colours marked Good, but the grips and bindings now come from each mod's own weapons instead of Spartan's oak and copper. Elementus goes ahead on 1.20.1 in its own round.

items.title: Iron's Spellbooks: Arcane weapons
items.detail: Same Arcane blade colours marked Good last round. Grip is now the dark leather from the Iron's Spellbooks Magehunter, and the bindings and pommel bands are the Magehunter's steel-blue guard.
items.ask: Good = ship this grip and binding, Needs changes = say what to shift, Bad = go back to Spartan's oak and copper.
